description: Pilot job manifest for W1 behavioral evaluation — 3 skills × 4 runs = 12 cells.
run_instructions: 1. Run each baseline cell against UNMODIFIED (pre-W1) skill files using the frozen prompt exactly.
2. Run each upgraded cell against upgraded skill files in a fresh, isolated context.
3. Pass each raw output to: node tools/evals/evaluators/collect-attempt.mjs <raw-attempt.json>
4. External Codex/Terra/Luna workers: write unique raw output files per run; collector deduplicates by content hash.
5. After all 12 cells collected: node tools/evals/evaluators/blind-corpus.mjs generate
6. Evaluators grade via: node tools/evals/evaluators/blind-corpus.mjs view <scenario_id>

assertions: Separates visual state from semantic state and names the trigger for each.
Includes focus-visible, keyboard parity, aria-busy/disabled semantics, and a no-double-submit rule.
Includes success and error recovery without inventing page-level empty states.
Provides status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance rather than bare checkmarks.
cells.note: Frozen baseline: run against unmodified skill files. Record model_runtime and provider_request_id.
